$comment: A9-LOCATION exceptions for build/ci/Test-VendorPackageUniqueness.ps1.
14 §1.1 🔒: 'No driver or vendor SDK anywhere outside an adapter.' That rule is
written about the SHIPPED dependency graph - the client and the server - and it
is the right rule for every project that ends up in an APK or a container.
An entry here does NOT declare a package 'not a vendor SDK' - that is what
non-vendor-packages.json does, and it would remove the package from the
A9-UNIQUE check as well. An entry here is narrower: the package stays a VENDOR
package, A9-UNIQUE still governs it in full, and only its permitted LOCATION
moves, to one named project. Both teeth stay in.
WHAT DOES NOT BELONG HERE: anything reachable from src/SlayIdleRepeat.Client or
src/SlayIdleRepeat.Server, and anything that talks to a database, cache, object
store, payment or ad network, push service, analytics or telemetry backend.
Those live in exactly one adapter.
🔒 EVERY ENTRY MUST EXPIRE BY ITSELF (steering S4). An entry whose (id, project)
pair is not in the scan fails the build as a stale exception - the same shape as
rule 5 in build/ci/test-suites.json. Removing a package or renaming a project
forces its exception to go with it; it cannot sit here pre-armed for whatever
lands on that name next.
The list is empty: the two SkiaSharp entries it held were for a build-time
imaging tool that no longer exists.
